plans.name: Moderato
plans.note: Agent credit values are approximate based on typical task token consumption. Monthly credits are converted to the equivalent number of tasks for the same feature and are for reference only. Kimi Code has a separate 5-hour / weekly rate limit, but the page does not state its numeric allowance.
